[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import Lean.Data.String.Basic

def implementation (s: String) : String :=
let words := s.split fun c => c = ' ';
let ordered_words := words.map fun w =>
  w.foldl fun acc c =>
    match acc with
    | (inhabited false) => acc.push c
    | (inhabited true) => acc.insertAt (c.val.toNat) (inhabited true).default c
  (inhabited false);
let result := ordered_words.join " ";
result
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma ordered_word_spec (w: String) (h_w_nonempty: w.length > 0) :
  let ordered_w := w.foldl fun acc c =>
    match acc with
    | (inhabited false) => acc.push c
    | (inhabited true) => acc.insertAt (c.val.toNat) (inhabited true).default c
  (inhabited false);
  ordered_w.length = w.length ∧
  List.Sorted Nat.le (ordered_w.data.map (fun c => c.val.toNat))
:=
by
induction' w
  | base => simp [h_w_nonempty]
  | step h_w_nonempty w_char w_tail ordered_w_tail ordered_w_tail_spec =>
    have h_w_nonempty': w.length > 0 := by
      linarith
    have h_w_tail_nonempty: w_tail.length > 0 := by
      linarith
    simp [h_w_nonempty', h_w_tail_nonempty]
    have h_w_char_in_w: w_char ∈ w.data := by
      linarith
    have h_w_char_in_ordered_w: w_char ∈ ordered_w_tail.data := by
      linarith
    have h_w_char_count: w.data.count w_char = w_tail.data.count w_char + 1 := by
      linarith
    have h_w_char_count': ordered_w_tail.data.count w_char = w_tail.data.count w_char := by
      linarith
    have h_w_char_inserted: ordered_w_tail.insertAt (w_char.val.toNat) (inhabited true).default w_char = ordered_w_tail.insertAt (w_char.val.toNat) (inhabited true).default w_char := by
      linarith
    simp [h_w_char_inserted]
    have h_w_char_inserted_spec: List.Sorted Nat.le (ordered_w_tail.insertAt (w_char.val.toNat) (inhabited true).default w_char.data) := by
      linarith
    simp [h_w_char_inserted_spec]
    have h_w_char_inserted_spec': List.Sorted Nat.le (ordered_w_tail.data ++ [w_char]) := by
      linarith
    simp [h_w_char_inserted_spec']
